snippet.title: 30초. 신생아가 어린이가 되기까지.
snippet.description:
F엄마 이거 만들면서 또 울었죠 개인적으로 만 4 세때...뭔가 볼살도 줄어들고 훌쩍 큰 느낌이 들어요. 연말, 지금 가장 어릴 내새꾸들 안고 잘 보내셔요.❣️❣️ 그리구, 오랫동안 사랑해주셔서 감사합니다

This sentimental mommy cried again while making this. I thought, when they turn four… their baby cheeks start to fade and they suddenly feel so much more grown up. As the year comes to an end, I hope you enjoy this time with your little ones while they’re still their tiniest. ❣️❣️
And thank you so much for loving us for so long.
